expectation_basis: Original hand-authored wire-preservation contract; the isolated invalid-loop plan is never passed to a JMeter or nongui harness.

comparator_contract.reason: The static validator can inspect preserved wire values; no runtime comparator or JMeter harness is permitted.
comparator_contract.wire_comparison: exact; every retained wire name, node kind, and value is compared without normalization

save_service_contract.responseFile: absent if an independent serializer inspects the properties; no JTL is produced by this case

assertion_results.absence: not applicable; this syntax-only plan must not produce a JTL

negative_cases.upstream_semantics: not executed; this syntax-only input must never be promoted to an executable oracle plan
negative_cases.rust_policy_boundary: typed invalid-loop-count diagnostic; never reinterpret as forever or zero

negative_cases.upstream_semantics: -1 selects forever; this static-only input is never executed
negative_cases.rust_policy_boundary: preserve the wire value as a static constraint and require an explicit bounded execution policy before accepting it

negative_cases.upstream_semantics: deadline is already expired, so the child is not selected
negative_cases.rust_policy_boundary: an implementation may reject negative seconds explicitly, but must preserve the original wire value and must not call rejection an upstream execution result

negative_cases.upstream_semantics: missing condition resolves to the empty/false condition and selects no child
negative_cases.rust_policy_boundary: an implementation may report a typed missing-property diagnostic while retaining the absent property

negative_cases.upstream_semantics: built-in RandomController selects one child from its child set on each iteration; no fixed random choice or seed is claimed
negative_cases.rust_policy_boundary: the Rust subset may return runtime.controller.unsupported until RandomController is implemented; this is not an Apache JMeter unsupported-element result
